artifacts.summary: Four-phase plan: author a creation-ready proposal packet for the six /slice successor records, audit it and record follow-up evidence, revise the descriptions of 694 and 655, and write the foreground creation runbook. Record creation and all fifteen edges are deferred to a foreground surface.

memory_candidates.content: A task whose stated deliverable is 'create N task records and edge them' cannot be executed by an autonomous dispatch: multi-task-creation-standard.md's 'Requesting a Proposal Packet, Not Filing, From an Autonomous Dispatch' section makes confirmed creation foreground-only, and state-write.sh's audit-evidence gate refuses a new active_projects entry without a matching audit verdict or a human-authored override. Plan such a task as: proposal packet keyed by slug (full descriptions, file_scope, edges by slug), pre-computed audit-task-proposals.sh verdicts, one issue-record.sh --suggested-channel follow_up_task entry per candidate, and a foreground runbook. Description revisions of existing records remain doable by the dispatch via skill-reviser Stage 7's state-write.sh block. Do not remove a stale dependency edge from an existing record ahead of adding its replacements: removal alone can make the record dispatchable early.
